about.description: UNITREE is a private-company perpetual listed on Gate, tracking Hangzhou Yushu Technology Co., Ltd., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 10× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
